## Downloading and Cleaning Data

```{r one}
my_data <- RKaggle::get_dataset("albucathecoder/adcc-matches")
my_data$victory_method <- as.factor(my_data$victory_method)
my_data$weight_class <- as.factor(my_data$weight_class)
my_data$submission <- as.factor(my_data$submission)
my_data$submission_target <- as.factor(my_data$submission_target)
my_data$submission_target <- na_if(my_data$submission_target, "nan")
my_data$absolute <- as.factor(my_data$absolute)
my_data$female <- as.factor(my_data$female)
head(my_data)
#summary(my_data)
sapply(my_data, class) 
#my_data$my_column <- as.factor(my_data$victory_method)
```

## Creating MLM Model

```{r three}
#use logistic glm b/c categorical and yes/no results
mlm <- multinom(victory_method ~ winner_points + loser_points + female + year + 
                absolute + weight_class + importance + total_points, 
                data = df)

summary(mlm)
vif(mlm)
```

```{r}
z <- summary(mlm)$coefficients / summary(mlm)$standard.errors
```

## Clustering Model

```{r}

kp_model <- kproto(x = df, k = 3, nstart = 10)
kp_model$center
kp_model$size
```

```{r}
install.packages("clustMixType")
library(clustMixType)
```

```{r}

set.seed(123)

# 1. Estimate a fixed lambda for consistent distance scaling across k
est_lambda <- lambdaest(df, verbose = FALSE)

# 2. Run kproto for k = 1 to 10 and extract tot.withinss
k_values <- 1:10
tot_withinss <- sapply(k_values, function(k) {
  model <- kproto(
    x = df, 
    k = k, 
    lambda = est_lambda, 
    nstart = 10,      # Multiple random starts prevent local minima
    verbose = FALSE
  )
  model$tot.withinss
})

# elbow plot
elbow_df <- data.frame(k = k_values, tot_withinss = tot_withinss)

ggplot(elbow_df, aes(x = k, y = tot_withinss)) +
  geom_line(color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue", size = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = k_values) +
  labs(
    title = "Elbow Method for k-Prototypes",
    x = "Number of Clusters (k)",
    y = "Total Within-Cluster Distance (tot.withinss)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

```
